R10: an ai caller is refused AI_CREDENTIAL_REVOKED (C-29.7) when its credential is withdrawn, and AI_BEYOND_TASK_SCOPE (C-29.6) when no member reaches the op or the op is mutating and not among its declared writes

R11: a session missing the op's capability is refused 403 NOT_CAPABLE (C-38.5) naming needs and held; a binding class holds no capabilities and is bounded by R9 alone; a session creating a project without create_projects is refused the same

R12: a bearer asking adminendorse, adminremove or membercaps is refused 403 OPERATOR_TOKEN_CANNOT_GOVERN (C-32.17); groupnameset or groupdomainset GROUP_IDENTITY_NEEDS_SESSION (C-64.4); each names the class

R5–R12, R20: the admission runs in one order — R1, R20's address gate, R6's agent lookup, R2, R3, the public ops, then the class with R8's session gate, R7, R10 or R9, R11, R4's scope refusal, then R12 — and stops at the first refusal

R5: a token equal to ADMIN_TOKEN, PROBE_TOKEN or DAEMON_TOKEN (checked in the order admin, member, probe, daemon) gives that class only while the binding is live; MEMBER_TOKEN gives no class (T36); any other token gives no binding class

R6: an aik-<64 hex> token is resolved once per request against bio's credential rows (class ai with its principal, scope and confinement); a 64-hex token is resolved as a session against bio; a store that does not answer either lookup is a silence, never a statement about the caller
R7: a caller with no class is refused 401 NOT_AUTHENTICATED (C-38.1), for every gated op (anonymous list, search, projection and image among them)

R6: both lookups are credentials' (K637): the routes the module asks, `session` and `aicredentiallook`, the token and the digest in the `x-bio-session` and `x-bio-credential-sha` headers that store-door hands to credentials' own op map as `t` and `sha` (K2038), are answered through its `session` (its R5) and `aiCredentialLook` (its R15), and membership's map answers neither; nothing of either is in the address

R17: websiteinvite and joinlinkinvite are public ops admitted with no credential; a credential or session presented (by header or body) is neither required nor used, nothing about the caller reaches the act, the key, link and cover are read from the body only, the one limit admission adds is R21's per-source window (the daily caps are membership's), and no key, link or invitation appears in a refusal

R18: the administrator's acts op-declarations R22 declares are admitted as their specs say and reach membership, whose NOT_AN_ADMIN answers a caller who is not an administrator, a machine credential included; R12's bearer fences do not name them and admission adds no fence

R18 (T49; op-declarations R71, control-plane R97): founderhandleset is the founder's own session's act — read from its spec, only SESSION_OPS.admin holds it: the founder's session is admitted, a member's session (an enrolled administrator's included) is refused 403 SESSION_ROLE_CANNOT_REACH_OP naming the founder, and admission adds no fence of its own

R19: the group key's ops are admitted only from a session — a bearer, a machine credential and an operator token are refused CLASS_FORBIDDEN naming the class, an ai credential is refused before any store call, none is on AI_GRANT_OPS; a member's session reaches credentials, which answers NOT_AN_ADMIN; groupkeyset's key is read from the body only and appears in no refusal

R14: the admission share of the checks is this module's own — C-38.1–C-38.11, C-78.1–C-78.3, C-29.6–C-29.10, C-29.30, C-32.17, C-64.4 — each raised by a gate here, carrying its row's check and its word (R28: `refusal.<CODE>`), each row's `where` naming a site in this module
R15: no credential, session token or secret appears in any refusal this module answers, and no place is named in its behaviour or outward text
R1: a store= present and not exactly bio or scratch is refused 400 NAMESPACE_UNKNOWN (C-78.1), naming the namespaces, for every caller and the page; nothing is read

R33: an act that asks the password again has the session and the re-authentication due asked in one hop (both on the wire before either is answered), each once, with the session's token in a header
R33: every other answer of the chain is unchanged when the two are issued together — a locked session, an unknown token, a missing capability, a silent session and a silent question

R32: a gated op reads its session once through the reader and the admission
R32: the window, the reader and the admission together read the session once
R32: the memo is for that request only: a second request, with its own credential, reads again
R32 (control): a background request and a foreground one are different reads, and neither is merged into the other
R32 (control): a session the store does not know is read once and answered as no one both times
R32 (control): a store that does not answer the session read is one silence, named by the same correlation, to each gate

R32 (control): other credentials of the same request are not merged: a different session token is its own read
R32 (control): the locked and ended state of a session are as one read gives them to every gate

R21: countryOf answers Cloudflare's two-character label or null; the window's bound is 300 per source in 10 minutes, its estimate prev × (1 − elapsed/W) + cur, refused at ≥ 300 with 429 DOOR_RATE_LIMITED (C-38.9) carrying stated (composed from the same constants) and retryAfter in whole seconds, naming no address

R22 (T36: written through credentials' securitycount, its R50): securityTally counts each refusal once — kind credential (a revoked or expired agent credential, the retired member key, an unknown aik- credential, invitelook/enroll NO_SUCH_INVITATION, websiteinvite WEBSITE_KEY_UNKNOWN, joinlinkinvite NO_SUCH_JOIN_LINK), kind rate (DOOR_RATE_LIMITED, WEBSITE_DAILY_CAP, JOIN_LINK_DAILY_CAP); country from countryOf, null when the credential names a member; only kind and country reach the store, in the body of one POST to bio's internal route securitycount; every other answer is null and writes nothing; a count that cannot be written is dropped; it never throws and never changes the refusal

R20: a sentinel credential sent by header and by body to one op of each kind (a session's, an agent credential's, a binding class's, a grant's door, a review door, a public op) meets the same admission; by the address, alone and beside a header, it is refused 400 CREDENTIAL_IN_ADDRESS (C-38.10) with no request to the store, and the sentinel is in no answer and no address of any request the module makes

R5 (T36): no binding class member exists — a live MEMBER_TOKEN presented by header or by body gives no class and is refused 401 MEMBER_TOKEN_RETIRED (C-38.11) for every gated op, before anything is looked up, read or written; all four bindings are still compared; with no MEMBER_TOKEN bound, a value once held is any unknown credential (R7)

tests: R21 (27b): fifty counted requests change at most two rows — by source and by session — and the flush is the write

R27 (store side): a session's own window — SESSION_WINDOW is frozen {limit: 3000, windowMs: 600000}, its stated sentence composed from the same constants; a request carrying a session's digest is counted in that window and never in its source's; at an estimate of 3000 or more it is refused counting nothing, with stated and retryAfter; the estimate slides as R21's does; rows hold the digest, the bucket and the count, never the token, and are dropped once both buckets have passed; a value that is no digest is counted by source; the table is declared with R21's classes

R27 (the gate): a public read presenting a live session — header or body — is counted in that session's window and not its source's: 400 signed-in page loads in 10 minutes, each making the public reads M-T49-4 measured (the shell's and Home's groupidentity, bootstrap and grouplanguages, 5), are admitted under one session from one source, and that source's window is not counted by them; the token goes only in the session lookup's header, the digest in the window's body

R27 (the limit): a session's request past SESSION_WINDOW.limit is refused 429 DOOR_RATE_LIMITED (C-38.9) with SESSION_WINDOW_STATED, retryAfter and minutes, before the op runs, counted nowhere; the same session's refusal does not close its source's window; it is counted in R22's tally as kind rate with country null

R27 (controls): everything but a live session's public read stays in its source's window — 301 anonymous requests from one source are refused at the 301st; an unknown 64-hex token, an ended or locked session, an `aik-` credential and each binding token are counted by source, as is a session the store could not be asked about; a signed-in session's enroll (and every mutating public op) is counted by source; a gated op is never counted
